summary: Zero Trust network access platform using peer-to-peer WireGuard to securely connect people, machines, and AI agents across any network.
usecases: Secure remote access to internal services without VPNs
Connect distributed microservices and edge devices in a mesh network
Enable AI agent collaboration across untrusted networks
ideas: Combine with Tailscale or Headscale for hybrid mesh networking
Build a secure P2P collaboration platform for distributed teams
Integrate with identity providers like OIDC for seamless Zero Trust onboarding
